timeline.summary: The Curfew of Silver decree requires blessed silver amulets for Kessig commoners after dark; relations with Gavony worsen.
timeline.quote: Since the Curfew of Silver, relations between Kessig and Gavony have worsened.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alchemist Theodora Glick forces the captured Guthril to stay human for three lunar cycles, but he re-emerges and destroys her laboratory in Gavony.
timeline.quote: He utterly destroyed Glick's laboratory in Gavony and fled into the night.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bishop Volpaig, secretly a Skirsdag servant, learns that his master Griselbrand has fallen into the Helvault and grows more open about his allegiance.
timeline.quote: has overheard that his master Griselbrand has fallen into the Helvault

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn finds the lost boy Maeli huddled in the crook of a tree after lighting up the forest and calling for him.
timeline.quote: Avacyn fixed the location of the child in her mind, and swooped over and down to a spot in the forest a few minutes away.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn returns Maeli to his mother Kelse, and feels satisfied that this is why she exists.
timeline.quote: It took only moments for her to find the mother on the outskirts of the trees and give her the child.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: A violent shimmer racks Avacyn, doubling her vision and leaving a constant buzzing in her ears.
timeline.quote: A violent shimmer wracked her body, shaking her vision.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees Kelse turn angry at Maeli and a thought comes to her that mortals are rotten, turning her view of the child from innocence to disgust.
timeline.quote: The seeds of men are rotten.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn flees the scene, her mind consumed by the buzzing and the same words repeating.
timeline.quote: Avacyn fled, seeking refuge from her own mind.

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reaches the Gavony moors in the rain, relieved from the delusions of Markov Manor, and starts reading the journal.
timeline.quote: It was still evening when he reached Gavony.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace finds a twisted monolith on the moor matching those at Markov Manor and in the journal.
timeline.quote: The monolith was unmistakably the same as those he had seen at Markov Manor, the same as he had seen in the journal.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: A spark jumps from the monolith to Jace's hand, and he senses something bright and bell-clear.
timeline.quote: there was a POP and a spark jumped from the end of the monolith to his hand.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 643: the cryptoliths warp mana flow, with potentially severe effects on angels.
timeline.quote: The disruptive properties of the stones appear to also extend to an ability to warp the flow of mana through the region

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
timeline.quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia recalls being forced to kill her scout Halmig, who rejoined the march changed and squirming.
timeline.quote: She had been forced to kill him, or whatever he had become

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
timeline.quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's hand is burned by holy light when she tries to touch the spear.
timeline.quote: A flare of holy light erupted where her hand touched the metal haft

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
timeline.quote: We ride under this banner now,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia shows her army the spear and tells them Avacyn is gone, urging them to be their own light.
timeline.quote: For the memory of Avacyn, of the light and goodness that have fled from the world, we fight!

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A monster fused from a horse and rider attacks Thalia, numbing her face before her gryff and cathars kill it.
timeline.quote: But then she strayed too close to a shambling thing the size of a large horse, and it wheeled on her.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Dennias is overtaken by magenta tendrils from his body and Thalia kills him mercifully.
timeline.quote: Her blade took his life quickly

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
timeline.quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
timeline.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Thalia meets the geist of Saint Traft in an ancient chapel and takes him in.
timeline.quote: Will you take me in?

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: In Gavony an old woman tells the group that Dennick, Worrin's son, holed up in the old family mansion.
timeline.quote: "He holed up in the old family mansion.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
timeline.quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
timeline.quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The spirit of Dennick Betzold tells the group the Key was given to Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: they found the spirit of Dennick Betzold who tells the group the location of the Key

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group learns from the zombified Worrin Betzold and the spirit of Dennick Betzold that the Key went to Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: the Key was given by his great-grandfather to Sorin Markov

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to hand over the Key and attacks Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops him, and the group finds the Key in his quarters.
timeline.quote: In the second attack Sigarda appears

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
